title: Your Champion Left. A New Contact Won't Replace Them.
excerpt: When a customer champion leaves, check which commitments lost knowledge, influence or decision authority before keeping the old account plan.
primary_goal: Decide which customer commitment can continue, must change or should wait after a champion departs.
primary_cta: Run the Champion Change Check on one live commitment after a stakeholder change.
playbook_description: A one-page check for the work, authority and commitments left open when a customer champion leaves.

subject_variants.label: primary
subject_variants.subject: Your champion left. Who owns the next decision?
subject_variants.preheader: Check what the new contact can actually take forward before keeping the old plan.
